# The recorded medians of the performance regression gate (ADR-0040 item 5,
# .github/scripts/bench-gate.py): <case> <median> <unit> <margin %>.
# Recorded by bench-gate.py record from 25 CI runs, each the best of its result files as compare judges them, the margin twice the slowest run's distance
# from the median, rounded up to 5 %, at least 100 % and at least two units of a time printed
# in whole units.
# The scale test of a pull request (SDN-18 #194): the scenario of controller/internal/nodesim/scale.go at a tenth of the target,
# 1,000 nodes, 100 VRFs and 10,000 routes. The step Performance regression gate at a tenth of the target of the job scale (Linux)
# in ranz.yml compares the BENCH lines of each run with these medians: the best of the 3 enrolments and of the 3 changes of every
# VRF of a run, and the one change of a route.
# Recorded again for CI-FLAKE-9 (#616) with bench-gate.py record --per-run --min-margin 100, one RESULTS argument (the scale-bench*.txt
# files) for each of 25 runs, each on a runner of its own, the slow runners of the day among them. The floor of 100 % is the one that
# this file had: a run twice as slow as the median of the runs is a regression and not a noisy runner. The runs, by run id:
#   41407238785  the job scale (Linux) of pull request 618 at 8bd75773, job 125152248823, artifact ranz-scale-pr
#   41440174498  the steps of that job on 16 runners (scale-stress-616.yml at bb7e6baf), the jobs scale (Linux) copy 1 to 16, the
#                artifacts ranz-scale-pr-1 to ranz-scale-pr-16
#   41407229696  the first of the four runs on each of 8 runners (scale-stress-616.yml at 8bd75773), the jobs stress 1 to 8, the
#                artifacts scale-stress-1 to scale-stress-8, directory run1
# Between these runners the best of three enrolments took 2.7 s to 4.2 s and the apply of the best of three changes 0.7 s to 1.3 s:
# the CPU of the runner (AMD EPYC 7763, 9V74 and 9V45, Intel Xeon 6973P-C and Platinum 8573C) and the moment set most of it. A case
# that a run measures once (scale_route_apply and scale_route_ack_max) is one sample: its slowest run took 4.2 s against a median of
# 1.9 s, which is why its margin is wider than the floor.
scale_change_ack_max 1296.4 ms 100
scale_change_ack_p50 1229.9 ms 100
scale_change_ack_p90 1281.5 ms 100
scale_change_ack_p99 1292.8 ms 100
scale_change_apply 1166.4 ms 100
scale_enrol_ack_p50 662.2 ms 255
scale_enrol_ack_p99 1041.6 ms 160
scale_enrol_converge 3483.2 ms 100
scale_enrol_rate 287.1 ops/s 100
scale_route_ack_max 1943 ms 230
scale_route_apply 1941.3 ms 230
scale_setup_apply 1051.8 ms 100
